seo.title: Rebel Phinisi: Komodo & Raja Ampat Yacht Charter
seo.description: Rebel, Rascal Voyages' 30m phinisi from 2020: five cabins for 10 guests, a wine cellar and outdoor cinema, a PADI instructor. Charter from US$13,500 a night.

tagline: Rascal's younger sister: a 30-metre phinisi from 2020 with a wine cellar and a cinema under the stars
answer: Rebel is a 30-metre traditional handmade phinisi built of ironwood in Sulawesi in 2020 by Rascal Voyages. She takes up to 10 guests in five en-suite cabins with a crew of 12 and a PADI dive instructor, and adds a wine cellar and an outdoor cinema. She charters whole from US$13,500 a night plus taxes, or by the cabin; Komodo runs May to October and Raja Ampat October to April.

overview: Rebel is a traditional handmade phinisi built of ironwood in Sulawesi in 2020 by the builders of her sister Rascal, Pak Haji Wahab and Raul Boscarino. She is 30 metres overall with a 7.4 metre beam, and Rascal Voyages describes her interiors as "modern laid-back luxe with a tribal vibe", with hand-woven fabrics and carvings inspired by Indonesian craft.

Five en-suite cabins take up to 10 guests: the Master Cabin, 5.8 by 4.3 metres, and Cabin 4 on the upper deck with king beds and daybeds; Cabins 1 and 2 on the main deck with queen beds, and Cabin 3 with a double and a king single bunk. Twelve crew sail her, among them a PADI dive instructor.

Beyond Rascal's six deck areas and roof deck, Rebel has a wine cellar stocked with old and new world wines and a cinema under the stars. Rascal Voyages sails her in Komodo from May to October and Raja Ampat from October to April.
why: She is the most finished of the three Rascal yachts: the newest build, bigger main deck cabins than Rascal's, a wine cellar and a cinema, at a published US$13,500 a night for the yacht.
Everything Rascal Voyages runs on Rascal runs on Rebel: the same itineraries, the dive instructor, the pop-up beach dinners and the published, nearly all-inclusive pricing.

days.title: Labuan Bajo to Sebayor Island
days.summary: Board at 11am in Labuan Bajo and sail to Sebayor for snorkelling, paddleboarding or a first dive, watching for white-spotted eagle rays. Sundowners on the roof deck facing Sangeang volcano.

days.title: Sape Bay and the pink beaches
days.summary: The pink beaches by kayak, snorkel or dive, with long-tailed macaques ashore and blacktip reef sharks in the shallows; lunch at a pop-up beach club.

days.title: Komodo Island, Siaba Besar and Gili Lawa Darat
days.summary: A guided walk at Loh Liang to look for Komodo dragons, then drifting with hawksbill and green turtles at Siaba Besar before Gili Lawa Darat.

days.title: Taka Makassar, Tatawa Besar and Seraya
days.summary: Snorkel or dive with manta rays, walk the white sandbar of Taka Makassar, then dinner at a lantern-lit pop-up on a beach by tender.

days.title: Seraya to Labuan Bajo
days.summary: A last morning of sailing and swimming, disembarking after lunch at 1pm, with dolphins sometimes in the wake.

days.title: Sorong to Kali Biru, Waigeo
days.summary: Board in Sorong and cross to Waigeo for the blue river of Kali Biru, Papuan hornbills and sea eagles, and the first sunset on the top deck.

days.title: Mioskon, Kri and Mansuar
days.summary: Snorkel or dive Mioskon or Blue Magic, Cape Kri and Sawandarek in the Dampier Strait, and visit a village with its tribal leader.

days.title: The Yeben archipelago
days.summary: Reefs, turtles and wobbegong sharks, and a private beach club set up for the day.

days.title: Arborek and Penemu
days.summary: Snorkel or dive with manta rays at manta point and Melissa's Garden, then walk up to Penemu's viewpoint.

days.title: Misool: Tomolol and Yilliet
days.summary: A lake of stingless jellyfish in the morning, then the reefs of Yilliet Kecil and Romeo; a night dive or snorkel for the epaulette walking shark.

days.title: Fiabacet and Tomolol
days.summary: Puri Pinnacle for devil rays, the climb to Pucak Harfat over the lagoons, the rock art of Tomolol and a pop-up dinner on a beach.

days.title: Sagof and Balbulol
days.summary: A last dive at Two Tree, then kayaks and paddleboards inside Balbulol's lagoon.

days.title: Sorong
days.summary: Breakfast aboard, then the crew drive you to the airport.

faqs: How much does it cost to charter Rebel?
Rascal Voyages publishes US$13,500 a night plus taxes for the whole yacht, up to 10 guests, with accommodation, airport transfers, all activities, park fees and excursions included and alcohol extra.
What is the difference between Rebel and Rascal?

Both are 30-metre phinisis for 10 guests in five cabins with 12 crew. Rebel was built in 2020, five years after Rascal, has larger main deck cabins, and adds a wine cellar and an outdoor cinema; she charters at US$13,500 a night against Rascal's US$12,000.
Can we book a single cabin on Rebel?
Yes. Rascal Voyages sells cabin voyages from US$2,500 a night per cabin plus taxes. Ask James which dates are open on Rebel.
How many guests does Rebel take?
Up to 10, in five en-suite cabins: the Master and Cabin 4 on the upper deck with king beds and daybeds, Cabins 1 and 2 with queen beds, and Cabin 3 with a bunk.
When does Rebel sail Komodo and Raja Ampat?
Rascal Voyages runs Komodo from May to October from Labuan Bajo, and Raja Ampat from October to April from Sorong.
Yes: full scuba equipment and an onboard PADI dive instructor, with certification on request.
